employees.label: Full-time employees
employees.definition: Full-time employees in the United States and in international locations, as stated in the 10-K.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of January 31, 2026, we had 7,438 full-time employees. Of these employees, 3,457 are in the United States and 3,981 are in our international locations.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Approximately 103,000 square feet of leased commercial space.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in San Jose, California, where we lease approximately 103,000 square feet of commercial space pursuant to operating leases that expire in the fiscal year ending January 31, 2030.

notes: The FY2026 (Jan 31, 2026) 10-K splits full-time employees into the U.S. (3,457) and international locations (3,981) and names only the San Jose headquarters (about 103,000 sq ft leased); Item 2 says other offices are in the U.S., APAC and EMEA without counts. Risk factors mention R&D personnel in China but give no number. No state, country or tax breakdown was found in the filing.
